item.text: The existing upload parses inside the server process, so a slow or memory-heavy attachment can block health checks. I’m moving extraction into a bounded child process and retaining the current attachment storage behavior.

item.text:
Implemented purchase-order upload prefill using the supplied extraction library. Parsing runs in a separate process with input, output, time, memory-monitoring, and queue limits. Failed parsing leaves the original attachment available.

Verified the built service with a normal upload, failed-upload retention, parser isolation, memory and output-size probes, timeouts, queue saturation, and health checks during parsing. `bun test` also passes.

The RSS limit is enforced by sampling the parser process every 5 ms, so a brief memory spike between samples may exceed the limit before termination.
